items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And August. You know August? Yeah, sure. [INTERVIEWEE] I know them all.

ctx.x: Yeah, because he can consume some beer. Smoke some cigars, too. And eat some. You know, when Tony gets loaded, he gets crying, Jags. You ever eaten one of the crying kicks? He's a character. The only boy that could consume a beer was Bill Wally. Man, when I had them sessions at Mars, I used to order a case of beer extra for Bill. I know he'd drink damn near a case of beer.
And his brothers, too. Henry, too. And August. You know August? Yeah, sure.

I know them all. Henry used to come out there to the sessions. What are you talking about? A nice, a guy who plays relaxed music. It's him. You ever hear him play? Oh, he plays a nice kid, too. I played a benefit dance at Plum Plan one night. And it's a wonderful place to play. Paul's a good place. I was a good place to play. I was a good place to play. And it's a wonderful place to play, Paul. It's got a low tin roof. Man, that music really bounces back at you. And we had my little fella, Alvin, on piano. Henry…
